doc: bsv-low #499: the D1 ceilings of the budget tier (docs/D1-BUDGETS.md). Each ceiling is the figure measured on the fixture D1 (b1ad9a1 plus lane 499, 2026-10-07, identical at 300 and 1200 strangers) plus the margin below; raise one only with a new measurement and its reason in the doc.
margin: reads: measured x 1.5 rounded up, at least measured + 4; writes: measured + 2, and a route that measured 0 writes keeps 0 (a read that starts writing reds); stmts: measured + 2

owed-first-read.route: /owed?identity=A: the first read (the compute on read and its write)

submit-admit-1.route: /submit: an operator historical-tx-no-spv submit admitting one tm_collected output

record-potparty-filing.route: /record?kind=potparty: a signed stranger filing naming A's pot; all inline filing reads and marks

pot-changed-hook-1.route: /internal/pot-changed: B's pot, one outpoint, no decoded params, its two marker-named seats marked stale (E649 L4: the required read, the marker arms one batch each, ONE write batch of the stale marks and the outpoint's parked wake-up (H1); no walk, no relay call on the answer path)

pot-changed-hook-decoded-8.route: /internal/pot-changed: A's eight decoded pots, one latched seat each (E649 L4 M1, the decoded maximum body: one required batch of 8, the seat markers' batch, ONE write batch of 16 parked wake-ups; no marker arm is read)

pot-changed-hook-marker.route: /internal/pot-changed: the fixture's undecoded pot whose party and refund-backup markers name five identities with owed-state rows (E649 L4 M1, the marker fallback: the required read, three arm batches, ONE write batch of five stale marks and one park)

pot-changed-hook-8x19.route: /internal/pot-changed: seven decoded pots with two latched seats each and the marker pot naming five, 19 identities each with an owed-state row (E649 L4 M1, the review's H2 body: required batch of 8, seat markers, three arm batches over the one marker outpoint, ONE write batch of 5 stale marks and 22 parks)

pot-announce-drain.route: /internal/pot-announce-drain: one drain pass over the fixture's 24 due and 6 exhausted parked wake-ups (E649 L4 H1: the due read, LIMIT 24, then ONE write batch of 24 settles and the sweep, LIMIT 50)

censusKey: the d1Budget route a production census holds against this ceiling (advisory there: production rows are not the fixture's); null = the route's maximum is another scenario's
